item.text: {"branches":[{"elimination_condition":"Eliminate if increasing livebait use does not increase fish caught per hour after accounting for group size, children, camper status, and hours.","hypothesis_id":"H1","intervention":"Increase livebait use while holding persons, children, camper status, and fishing hours comparable.","mechanism":"Livebait increases attraction and capture success, raising catch rate.","mechanism_key":"livebait_positive_effect","predictions":[{"direction":"increase","discriminator_id":"D1","failure_condition":"Fish caught per hour is unchanged or decreases under increased livebait use.","observable":"Average fish caught divided by hours","prediction_id":"P1","value_range":null}]},{"elimination_condition":"Eliminate if increasing livebait use changes fish caught per hour in either direction after adjustment for the listed covariates.","hypothesis_id":"H2","intervention":"Increase livebait use while holding persons, children, camper status, and fishing hours comparable.","mechanism":"Livebait has no material effect on capture success; environmental and trip factors dominate.","mechanism_key":"livebait_null_effect","predictions":[{"direction":"no_change","discriminator_id":"D1","failure_condition":"Fish caught per hour systematically increases or decreases under increased livebait use.","observable":"Average fish caught divided by hours","prediction_id":"P2","value_range":null}]},{"elimination_condition":"Eliminate if increasing livebait use does not reduce fish caught per hour after adjustment for the listed covariates.","hypothesis_id":"H3","intervention":"Increase livebait use while holding persons, children, camper status, and fishing hours comparable.","mechanism":"Livebait is associated with less effective fishing conditions or behavior, lowering capture success.","mechanism_key":"livebait_negative_effect","predictions":[{"direction":"decrease","discriminator_id":"D1","failure_condition":"Fish caught per hour is unchanged or increases under increased livebait use.","observable":"Average fish caught divided by hours","prediction_id":"P3","value_range":null}]}],"budget_units":3,"question":"How many fish on average do visitors catch per hour while fishing, and how does livebait use influence this rate?"}
